description: Fetch a recipient's full profile including address, business type codes, parent organizations, alternate names, and total transaction and loan amounts. Recipient IDs are hexadecimal 8-4-4-4-12 hashes with a level suffix (-P parent, -C child, -R standalone) from usaspending_search_recipients or usaspending_get_award. Totals cover the trailing 12 months unless fiscal_year selects one fiscal year, and period names the window. parents lists every parent organization — a child often has several, and a parent lists itself — and each parent_id opens that parent in usaspending_get_recipient. For a -P parent, children lists its child recipients with their amounts over the same period, highest amount first, up to children_limit, and children_total counts them all; children is a best-effort second request, so when it fails the profile is still returned and unavailable_sections names children with its reason. For a recipient's totals by award type, use usaspending_spending_over_time with filters.recipient_id and award_type_codes. UEI and DUNS values can be used to cross-reference with SAM.gov and SEC EDGAR.

children_limit.description: Child recipients to return for a parent (-P) profile, highest amount first. Default 50, at most 500 per call. Ignored for -C and -R profiles.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year to scope the totals to (e.g., 2024, which runs October 2023 through September 2024). Omit for the trailing 12 months.

recipient_id.description: Recipient hexadecimal 8-4-4-4-12 hash with level suffix, e.g., b97d19b0-833c-8d8f-3a2c-157d04ea55ef-P — from usaspending_search_recipients or usaspending_get_award

name: usaspending_get_recipient

children.description: Child recipients of a parent (-P) over period, highest amount first, up to children_limit; affiliates with no transactions in the period are listed at 0. [] when the parent has none. Absent for -C and -R recipients, and when the children request failed (see unavailable_sections).

items.description: One child recipient; a member upstream leaves empty is omitted

amount.description: Transaction amount in USD over period; can be negative

recipient_id.description: Child recipient hash ID (ends in -C) — pass to usaspending_get_recipient for its profile

children_total.description: Number of child recipients the parent has over period, before children_limit. Present whenever children is.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `recipient_not_found`: No recipient found for the given recipient ID. `api_unavailable`: USAspending.gov API is unreachable or returns an error. `api_timeout`: USAspending.gov did not respond before the request deadline elapsed. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limitClamp.description: Present when a count input above its per-call cap was reduced to the cap.

applied.description: Value the call used: the per-call cap

notice.description: A reduced children_limit, how to see child recipients cut by children_limit, and which sections failed to load and whether a retry may recover them. Absent when none applies.

parent_id.description: Hash ID of the first parents entry (ends in -P) — pass to usaspending_get_recipient for that parent profile. Absent for a standalone (-R) recipient.

parent_name.description: Name of the first parents entry, which can be the recipient's own parent-level record; parents lists every parent

parent_uei.description: UEI of the first parents entry

parents.description: Every parent organization of the recipient, in upstream order: a child (-C) often has several and can list its own parent-level record, and a parent (-P) lists itself. Absent for a standalone (-R) recipient.

items.description: One parent organization; a member upstream leaves empty is omitted

parent_id.description: Parent recipient hash ID (ends in -P) — pass to usaspending_get_recipient for the parent profile

period.description: Window the totals cover: FY<year> when fiscal_year was given, otherwise "trailing 12 months"

recipient_level.description: Hierarchy level: P = parent, C = child, R = standalone

total_face_value_loan_amount.description: Total face value of loans in USD over period

total_face_value_loan_transactions.description: Number of face-value loan transactions over period

total_transaction_amount.description: Total transaction (award) amount in USD over period, across all award types

total_transactions.description: Total number of award transactions over period

truncated.description: True when children was cut to children_limit.

unavailable_sections.description: Sections omitted because their request failed while the profile loaded. Absent when every section loaded.

items.description: A section omitted from the result because its request failed

message.description: The failure message for this section.

reason.description: api_unavailable: USAspending was unreachable or answered with a server error. api_timeout: no answer before the request deadline. upstream_error: USAspending rejected the request, or its record lacks the identifier the section is requested by.

retryable.description: Whether retrying the call may load this section.

section.description: children: the child recipients of a parent profile (children, children_total).

title: Get Recipient Profile
